title: val_to_str[_ext] -> val_to_str[_ext]_wmem for generated dissectors
description: Convert to use wmem versions of val_to_str of generated dissectors (ASN.1 and DCE/RPC) to reduce use of wmem_packet_scope.

notes.body: @martin.r.mathieson - Can you comment/help on this?  Is this the first time some of the ASN.1 dissectors have been "tested" with newer checks (and they are now being targeted because they are modified in this MR).  This search/replace MR shouldn't have triggered anything bad.  I also thought errors would be in red for easier reading...

I'm not sure what the error is - looks like it was starting to re-generate all of the generated dissectors to check that it agrees with your version...

The only script where I made the error lines appear in red was checkAPIs.pl, I can certainly do this for the other perl and python scripts.

I checked out your branch, then re-generated all of the dissectors, i.e. went to wireshark-build/epan/dissectors and built in asn1, pidl and dcerpc

After that, I did a 'git diff' and I do see this:

        modified:   epan/dissectors/packet-dcerpc-atsvc.c
        modified:   epan/dissectors/packet-dcerpc-browser.c
        modified:   epan/dissectors/packet-dcerpc-drsuapi.c
        modified:   epan/dissectors/packet-dcerpc-dssetup.c
        modified:   epan/dissectors/packet-dcerpc-nspi.c
        modified:   epan/dissectors/packet-dcerpc-rfr.c
        modified:   epan/dissectors/packet-dcerpc-srvsvc.c

Not sure that's what the pipeline is complaining about, but will need to be fixed.
That is what it's complaining about. In the pipeline you can expand the "Regenerating PIDL dissectors" heading to see the diffs.
I stared, but did not see the '>' that could be expanded and the skip in line numbers.  Would be good if we could that line red :)
Yeah. There's also a ton of Perl warnings that seem to work but would be nice to fix to reduce clutter, but I am not a Perl guru. Also the code is shared with the Samba team.

I thought Wireshark "owned" the perl code to generate the dissectors (NDR.pm) and the Samba team "owned" the IDL files (which I didn't modify).  I remember having to deal with something similar when I was removing the proto_tree_add_text calls many years ago, but don't remember how it was resolved (but I can guarantee our buildbots were less picky than current pipeline).  But then the "new" NDR.pm would still generate code that would compile in "most" versions of Wireshark.  Here, I'm preparing to break API (with val_to_str[_ext] eventually requiring wmem scope and removing val_to_str[_ext]_wmem)
Is does look like the pipeline didn't use my modifications to NDR.pm and that's why there is a mismatch.  Is it somehow pulling the Samba version to ensure compatibility?
I don't think it's pulling the version. It might be doing something like using the version from the first commit instead of last commit, but I haven't checked by running your branch myself yet.
That idea just occurred to me too, and that's what the current pipeline should be testing (rebased to have the DCE/RPC commit first)

eti2wireshark: val_to_str[_ext] -> val_to_str[_ext]_wmem for generated dissectors

Convert to use wmem versions of val_to_str to reduce use of wmem_packet_scope.

Also fix generation to not generate g prefixed datatypes.
